note: Ten and Some More (numbers 11-19 with ten-frames). English only. Type A = count a ten-frame and pick the number (a*_q); type B = pick the matching ten-frame (b*_q); type C = drag apples into the boxes (c*_q). Runtime shuffles the ten questions.

lines.text: Let's count! We have one, two, three...
Look! Ten apples fill the box. This is a ten.
Ten apples, and three more apples. How many in total?
One, two, three... thirteen! One ten and three ones make thirteen.
Here is one ten. Add six more. What number is it?
One ten and six ones make sixteen.
Look at the ten-frame. How many apples in total?
Here is a full ten-frame. How many apples altogether?
Count them all. How many apples do you see?
A ten-frame and some more apples. How many in all?
Put fifteen apples in the boxes.
Put thirteen apples in the boxes.
Put seventeen apples in the boxes.
